name: Team Squirtle: Sevii Tides Vanguard
archetype: Sevii oceanic traversal & Chuck duel core — Water/Flying aerial hard-counter, Electric/Ground speed sweeping, Intimidate Attack reduction, Levitate Ground immunity, and Ice fortress coverage.
gym_duel_rationale: For Chuck's 5 vs 5 duel, Slots 1 through 5 take the field: Blastoise/Fearow (Slot 1) serves as Chuck's absolute nemesis, resisting Fighting attacks with its Flying type while carving through the team with STAB Drill Peck and dousing Blaziken/Wailord; Jolteon/Sandslash (Slot 2) provides high-speed Discharge to fry Wailord and Poliwrath, and Earthquake to shatter Kabutops; Alakazam/Weezing (Slot 5) floats above Earth Power with Levitate and sweeps with STAB Psychic; Arbok/Primeape (Slot 4) enters with Intimidate to defang physical attackers and lands 100% Glare paralysis; and Lapras (Slot 3) absorbs water moves with Water Absorb and provides Ice Beam coverage. Snorlax rests in reserve as the route endurance tank.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid at Cap 72. Flying typing resists Fighting moves. STAB Drill Peck cleanly dispatches Chuck's Fighting core with heavy super-effective damage, while Roost provides sustained recovery.
486 BST speed sweeper. STAB Discharge electrocutes Blaziken/Wailord and ocean water encounters. STAB Earthquake crushes Kabutops/Machamp and Rock types with massive force.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress. Water Absorb completely negates opposing water attacks across Brine Road and Deep Sea. STAB Ice Beam targets Lucario/Flygon for heavy super-effective damage.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Cuts Chuck's physical Attack on entry to blunt incoming Dynamic Punches and Close Combats. Glare inflicts guaranteed 100% paralysis on fast threats.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to Earth Power via Levitate. STAB Psychic eliminates Chuck's Fighting roster for effortless OHKOs.
Colossal 160 HP route sponge holding Leftovers. RestTalk loop absorbs deep-sea status and damage during exploration while resting in reserve during the 5v5 Gym duel.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control against wild encounters.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail for Water STAB coverage.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin for tactical versatility across route encounters.
